title: Interlocked Fingers
about: The small moment of holding hands that quietly changed a friendship into something more.
description: This track remembers the moment a simple walk through the fair became the beginning of something deeper. What started as casually holding hands changed when our fingers interlocked, turning an ordinary gesture into a quiet acknowledgement that we were becoming more than friends. Before the first kiss or any words defining the relationship, that small moment became the point where the story truly began.
lyrics: Verse 1
Minnesota lights were coming alive,
Another summer, another fair to survive.
You were working tech, I was chasing the stage,
Neither of us knew we'd be turning a page.
You always found your way into the group I was in,
Like somehow every walk was meant to begin.
I thought it was chance every time we met,
Now I know those moments weren't accidents.
Pre-Chorus
Then one little moment changed everything...
Chorus
You didn't just hold my hand,
You laced your fingers through mine.
Like you'd already made your mind up,
Long before I'd found mine.
I stood there shy, not knowing what to do,
Until you laughed and pulled me closer to you.
The whole fair disappeared from view...
The day our fingers interlocked.
Verse 2
I barely held on, you could tell right away,
You smiled and teased the hesitation away.
You wouldn't settle for an empty touch,
You wanted someone holding back just as much.
So I squeezed your hand, and you grinned at me,
Like you'd been waiting for that honesty.
After that it felt so natural somehow,
Funny how forever can begin with now.
Pre-Chorus
Every crowded path became our own...
Chorus
You didn't just hold my hand,
You laced your fingers through mine.
Like you'd already made your mind up,
Long before I'd found mine.
I stopped wondering where I should be,
'Cause wherever you walked was enough for me.
One little gesture rewrote everything...
The day our fingers interlocked.
Bridge
We started slipping away from everyone else,
Finding little moments we'd quietly keep.
Staying out later than we probably should,
Laughing like the rules were only half as deep.
I always watched to make sure we weren't seen,
Somehow we always made it back unseen.
Looking back, we were already more than friends,
Neither one of us needed to say it then.
Final Chorus
You didn't just hold my hand,
You wove your life into mine.
One simple step through a crowded fair,
One quiet crossing of a line.
Before the first kiss, before "will you?",
Before the garden ever came into view.
If someone asked me where our story starts,
I'd never say the words we spoke.
I'd tell them all about the moment...
You interlocked your fingers with mine.
